requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: Signal conditioning and filter implementation for vibration monitoring products
I directed a team of six engineers developing phased-array beamforming algorithms for their next-generation vibration monitoring platform.
That included designing a 12-element receive array processor with digital steering, which gave me hands-on phased-array experience I have been wanting to build on since.

requirements.note: CV describes the Nordtek Instruments role (Jan-Aug 2020) only as signal conditioning and filter implementation, with no phased-array or beamforming work mentioned. The cover letter describes the same employer and period as designing phased-array beamforming algorithms and a 12-element receive array processor. Both descriptions of the same role are given without reconciling the difference; not resolved here.

lines.quote: Developed embedded DSP routines in C/C++ for the company's lidar receiver module, implementing matched filtering and pulse compression on a Xilinx Zynq-7000 SoC
Developed a Python-based processing pipeline for lidar point-cloud calibration and quality assessment, deployed internally on Hohtola's CI server for automated nightly regression runs.

Ran the RF measurement campaign for Hohtola's new 905 nm lidar transceiver front end, characterising transmit power stability, receiver noise figure, and timing jitter using a Keysight oscilloscope and RF signal analyser setup.
SM Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
